scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @guoxue/contracts && npm run build --workspace @guoxue/web && npm run build --workspace @guoxue/server
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @guoxue/contracts && concurrently -n web,api,worker -c blue,red,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @guoxue/web" "npm run dev --workspace @guoxue/server" "npm run dev:worker --workspace @guoxue/server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @guoxue/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @guoxue/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @guoxue/server
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @guoxue/contracts && npm run test --workspace @guoxue/server && npm run test --workspace @guoxue/web
